name: 4x4x4 & Sides at UBC 2026

venue.name: [University of British Columbia](https://www.ubc.ca/)
venue.details: Irving K. Barber Learning Centre, Room 155

information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6Mzg0NzQsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--e6240fd13450938c58ea02a2948e07de0e818fb2/SpeedcubingCanadaLogo-724.png) ### IMPORTANT NOTE 1: Please be advised that this competition does not have 3x3x3 speedsolving. Refer to the [events tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/4x4x4SidesatUBC2026#competition-events) to see which events are being held. If you are looking to compete in events that are not being held at this one, please look for [other competitions in Canada](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions?region=CA). ### IMPORTANT NOTE 2: This competition is happening immediately after (and in the same room as) [FMC Canada 2026](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/FMCCanada2026). If you wish to compete in both, you must sign up for each competition individually. To get updates about future BC and/or Canadian competitions, join the [Speedcubing Canada mailing list](https://share.hsforms.com/1eWkfr6anSF-HKTZJVrElZQcrqzz). You are also welcome to join the Facebook group [Rubik's Cube Solvers British Columbia](https://www.facebook.com/groups/8336572494). Please **review all of the tabs listed on this website**. You **only need to show up for the events that you're competing in** - but we encourage you to show up for longer. Do note that we may run ahead of or behind schedule, so **please be ready at least 30 minutes in advance** just in case. An email will be sent out a few days before the competition with information/reminders. **Notice of filming and photography:** Attendees of Speedcubing Canada competitions consent to their images being used by Speedcubing Canada and its partners in marketing materials, social media and other digital platforms. **Health and Safety:** Masks will be optional at this event. Please stay home if you are sick or feeling unwell.
